label: Weights and range
subgoals: Assign weight minus two to the n minus one to the top bit
Sum the weights of the set bits
Bound the range from minus two to the n minus one up to two to the n minus one, minus one

label: Decoding a pattern
subgoals: Read the pattern as an unsigned integer
Subtract two to the n when the top bit is set
Confirm the result with the signed bit weights

label: Negation and the asymmetric corner
subgoals: Invert every bit of the pattern
Add one modulo two to the n
Flag the most negative value as its own negation
